title: Foundation
description: Use memorised words and phrases for the most basic needs: greetings, numbers and personal details, with help from the other person.

id.title: Dasar
id.description: Memakai kata dan frasa hafalan untuk kebutuhan paling dasar: salam, angka dan data pribadi, dengan bantuan lawan bicara.

nodes.title: Greetings & Politeness
nodes.summary: Say hello and goodbye at any time of day, use please, thank you, sorry and excuse me, and answer How are you?
nodes.canDo: Can greet people, say goodbye and use basic polite words in short everyday exchanges.

objectives.text: Greet people and say goodbye at different times of day (good morning, see you)
Use please, thank you, sorry and excuse me naturally
Ask and answer How are you? (I'm fine, thanks. And you?)

commonErrors.wrong: Good night! (said when arriving in the evening)
commonErrors.right: Good evening! (Good night is only for leaving or going to bed)

id.title: Salam & Sopan Santun
id.summary: Menyapa dan berpamitan di waktu yang berbeda, memakai please, thank you, sorry dan excuse me, serta menjawab How are you?
id.canDo: Bisa menyapa, berpamitan, dan memakai kata-kata sopan dasar dalam percakapan singkat sehari-hari.

objectives.greet-people-and: Menyapa orang dan berpamitan sesuai waktu (good morning, see you)
objectives.use-please-thank: Memakai please, thank you, sorry dan excuse me secara wajar
objectives.how-are-you: Menanyakan dan menjawab How are you? (I'm fine, thanks. And you?)

nodes.title: Alphabet & Sounds
nodes.summary: Name the 26 letters, hear the vowels and spell simple words aloud.
nodes.canDo: Can say the English alphabet and spell names and short words aloud.

objectives.text: Say and recognise the names of English letters
Identify the five vowel letters and their basic sounds
Spell short words and names letter by letter

commonErrors.wrong: E said like Indonesian 'e' and I like Indonesian 'i'
G and J read the Indonesian way ('ge', 'je')

id.title: Alfabet & Bunyi
id.summary: Sebutkan 26 huruf, kenali huruf vokal, dan eja kata sederhana dengan lantang.
id.canDo: Bisa menyebutkan alfabet bahasa Inggris serta mengeja nama dan kata pendek dengan lantang.

objectives.letter-names: Menyebut dan mengenali nama huruf dalam bahasa Inggris
objectives.vowels: Mengenali lima huruf vokal dan bunyi dasarnya
objectives.spelling: Mengeja kata pendek dan nama huruf demi huruf

nodes.title: English Sounds for Indonesian Speakers
nodes.summary: Practise the English sounds Indonesian speakers find hardest: long vs short vowels, th, v, sh and final consonants.
nodes.canDo: Can say common English words clearly enough to be understood, including sounds that do not exist in Indonesian.

objectives.text: Hear and say the difference between short and long vowels (ship / sheep)
Say the sounds /θ/, /ð/, /v/ and /ʃ/ clearly (think, this, very, she)
Pronounce final consonants clearly (cat, bed, bus)

commonErrors.wrong: think said as 'tink' /t/, this said as 'dis' /d/
commonErrors.right: think with /θ/ and this with /ð/ (tongue between the teeth)
very with /v/ (top teeth on the lower lip, with voice)

commonErrors.wrong: ship and sheep said the same; final sounds dropped (ca' for cat)
commonErrors.right: short /ɪ/ in ship, long /iː/ in sheep; finish the word: ca-t, be-d, bu-s

id.title: Bunyi Bahasa Inggris untuk Penutur Indonesia
id.summary: Latih bunyi yang paling sulit bagi penutur Indonesia: vokal pendek vs panjang, th, v, sh dan konsonan akhir.
id.canDo: Bisa mengucapkan kata-kata umum dengan cukup jelas untuk dipahami, termasuk bunyi yang tidak ada dalam bahasa Indonesia.

objectives.short-long-vowels: Mendengar dan mengucapkan perbedaan vokal pendek dan panjang (ship / sheep)
objectives.th-v-sh: Mengucapkan bunyi /θ/, /ð/, /v/ dan /ʃ/ dengan jelas (think, this, very, she)
objectives.final-consonants: Mengucapkan konsonan akhir dengan jelas (cat, bed, bus)

nodes.title: Classroom Language
nodes.summary: Ask for repetition, meaning and spelling, and follow simple classroom instructions.
nodes.canDo: Can ask for help with a word and follow simple instructions in class.

objectives.text: Ask someone to repeat or speak more slowly (Can you repeat that, please?)
Ask what a word means and how to spell it (What does … mean? How do you spell …?)
Understand simple classroom instructions (Listen. Repeat. Open your book.)

commonErrors.right: How do you spell your name?

id.title: Bahasa di Kelas
id.summary: Meminta pengulangan, arti dan ejaan kata, serta mengikuti instruksi kelas yang sederhana.
id.canDo: Bisa meminta bantuan soal kata yang belum kamu pahami dan mengikuti instruksi sederhana di kelas.

objectives.ask-someone-to: Meminta seseorang mengulang atau berbicara lebih pelan (Can you repeat that, please?)
objectives.ask-what-a: Menanyakan arti kata dan cara mengejanya (What does … mean? How do you spell …?)
objectives.follow-instructions: Memahami instruksi kelas yang sederhana (Listen. Repeat. Open your book.)

nodes.title: Personal Pronouns
nodes.summary: Use I, you, he, she, it, we, they and my, your, his, her.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about people and things with the right pronouns, keeping he and she apart.

objectives.text: Choose the right subject pronoun for people and things
Use possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, its, our, their
Replace a noun with the correct pronoun

commonErrors.wrong: My sister is a nurse. He works at a hospital.
commonErrors.right: My sister is a nurse. She works at a hospital.

commonErrors.wrong: This is Budi. He name is Budi.
commonErrors.right: This is Budi. His name is Budi.

commonErrors.wrong: This is Rina and she brother.
commonErrors.right: This is Rina and her brother.

id.title: Kata Ganti Orang
id.summary: Gunakan I, you, he, she, it, we, they serta my, your, his, her.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan orang dan benda dengan kata ganti yang tepat, tanpa tertukar antara he dan she.

objectives.subject-pronouns: Memilih kata ganti subjek yang tepat untuk orang dan benda
objectives.possessives: Memakai kata sifat kepemilikan: my, your, his, her, its, our, their
objectives.pronoun-reference: Mengganti kata benda dengan kata ganti yang tepat

nodes.title: Common Vocabulary
nodes.summary: Everyday nouns, numbers 1–20 and basic colours.
nodes.canDo: Can name everyday people, places and things, count to 20 and describe things with colours and simple adjectives.

objectives.text: Name common people, places and objects
Say and write numbers from 1 to 20
Describe things with basic colours and adjectives

id.title: Kosakata Umum
id.summary: Kata benda sehari-hari, angka 1–20 dan warna dasar.
id.canDo: Bisa menyebut orang, tempat dan benda sehari-hari, berhitung sampai 20, serta mendeskripsikan benda dengan warna dan kata sifat sederhana.

objectives.everyday-nouns: Menyebut orang, tempat dan benda yang umum
objectives.colours-adjectives: Mendeskripsikan benda dengan warna dan kata sifat dasar

nodes.title: Numbers to 100 & Prices
nodes.summary: Count from 21 to 100, give your age and phone number, and say prices in rupiah.
nodes.canDo: Can understand and say numbers, ages, phone numbers and simple prices.

objectives.text: Say and understand numbers from 21 to 100 (thirteen vs thirty)
Give your age and phone number (I'm 25. My number is 0812 …)
Say and understand prices, including thousands (It's 25,000 rupiah)

commonErrors.wrong: thirteen and thirty said the same way
commonErrors.right: thirTEEN (stress at the end) vs THIRty (stress at the start)

id.title: Angka sampai 100 & Harga
id.summary: Berhitung dari 21 sampai 100, menyebut umur dan nomor telepon, serta menyebut harga dalam rupiah.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami dan menyebut angka, umur, nomor telepon dan harga sederhana.

objectives.numbers-21-100: Mengucapkan dan memahami angka 21 sampai 100 (thirteen vs thirty)
objectives.age-phone: Menyebut umur dan nomor telepon (I'm 25. My number is 0812 …)
objectives.prices: Menyebut dan memahami harga, termasuk ribuan (It's 25,000 rupiah)

nodes.title: Days, Months & Time
nodes.summary: Name the days and months, tell the time and say dates with ordinal numbers.
nodes.canDo: Can say and understand days, dates and clock times for simple plans.

objectives.text: Name the days of the week and the months of the year
Tell the time (seven o'clock, half past six, 7:15)
Use ordinal numbers to say dates (the first of May)

id.title: Hari, Bulan & Jam
id.summary: Menyebut nama hari dan bulan, menyebut jam, dan menyebut tanggal dengan bilangan urutan.
id.canDo: Bisa menyebut dan memahami hari, tanggal dan jam untuk rencana sederhana.

objectives.days-months: Menyebut nama hari dalam seminggu dan nama bulan dalam setahun
objectives.telling-time: Menyebut jam (seven o'clock, half past six, 7:15)
objectives.ordinals-dates: Memakai bilangan urutan untuk menyebut tanggal (the first of May)

nodes.title: Countries & Personal Information
nodes.summary: Name countries and nationalities, give personal details and ask set questions like What's your name?
nodes.canDo: Can ask and answer simple questions about name, age, nationality, address and email.

objectives.text: Name countries and nationalities (Indonesia / Indonesian)
Give personal details: name, age, address and email
Ask and answer fixed questions (What's your name? Where are you from?)

id.title: Negara & Data Pribadi
id.summary: Menyebut negara dan kebangsaan, memberikan data pribadi, dan bertanya dengan frasa tetap seperti What's your name?
id.canDo: Bisa menanyakan dan menjawab pertanyaan sederhana tentang nama, umur, kebangsaan, alamat dan email.

objectives.personal-details: Memberikan data pribadi: nama, umur, alamat dan email
objectives.set-questions: Menanyakan dan menjawab pertanyaan tetap (What's your name? Where are you from?)

nodes.title: First Sentences with Be
nodes.summary: Introduce yourself with I'm …, talk about things with This is … and It's …, and never drop be.
nodes.canDo: Can introduce themselves and say what something is in short sentences with be.

objectives.text: Introduce yourself with I'm … and I'm from …
Use This is … and It's … to talk about things
Keep be in the sentence (I'm a teacher, not I teacher)

id.title: Kalimat Pertama dengan Be
id.summary: Perkenalkan diri dengan I'm …, bicarakan benda dengan This is … dan It's …, dan jangan pernah menghilangkan be.
id.canDo: Bisa memperkenalkan diri dan menyebut sesuatu itu apa dalam kalimat pendek dengan be.

objectives.introduce-yourself: Memperkenalkan diri dengan I'm … dan I'm from …
objectives.this-is-its: Memakai This is … dan It's … untuk membicarakan benda
objectives.keep-be: Tidak menghilangkan be dalam kalimat (I'm a teacher, bukan I teacher)

nodes.title: Basic Sentences
nodes.summary: Build Subject + Verb + Object sentences with a/an and plurals.
nodes.canDo: Can make simple sentences about people and things using a/an and plural nouns.

objectives.text: Build sentences in Subject + Verb + Object order
Use a and an correctly before nouns
Make regular plural nouns with -s / -es

id.title: Kalimat Dasar
id.summary: Susun kalimat Subjek + Kata Kerja + Objek dengan a/an dan bentuk jamak.
id.canDo: Bisa membuat kalimat sederhana tentang orang dan benda dengan a/an dan kata benda jamak.

objectives.word-order: Menyusun kalimat dengan urutan Subjek + Kata Kerja + Objek
objectives.articles: Menggunakan a dan an dengan benar sebelum kata benda
objectives.plurals: Membentuk kata benda jamak beraturan dengan -s / -es

nodes.title: Writing Basics
nodes.summary: Use capital letters and basic punctuation, write your personal details and fill in a simple form.
nodes.canDo: Can write their name, address, phone number and email correctly and fill in a simple form.

objectives.text: Use capital letters (I, names, the start of a sentence) and basic punctuation
Write your name, address, phone number and email correctly
Fill in a simple form (first name, surname, date of birth)

commonErrors.wrong: my name is budi and i live in bandung
commonErrors.right: My name is Budi and I live in Bandung.

id.title: Dasar Menulis
id.summary: Memakai huruf kapital dan tanda baca dasar, menulis data pribadi, dan mengisi formulir sederhana.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis nama, alamat, nomor telepon dan email dengan benar serta mengisi formulir sederhana.

objectives.capitals-punctuation: Memakai huruf kapital (I, nama, awal kalimat) dan tanda baca dasar
objectives.write-details: Menulis nama, alamat, nomor telepon dan email dengan benar
objectives.fill-form: Mengisi formulir sederhana (first name, surname, date of birth)

nodes.title: First Listening
nodes.summary: Catch letters, numbers and names spoken slowly, and understand greetings and classroom instructions.
nodes.canDo: Can recognise letters, numbers, names, greetings and simple instructions when people speak slowly and clearly.

objectives.text: Recognise letters, numbers and names spoken slowly
Understand greetings and classroom instructions

id.title: Menyimak Pertama
id.summary: Menangkap huruf, angka dan nama yang diucapkan pelan, serta memahami salam dan instruksi kelas.
id.canDo: Bisa mengenali huruf, angka, nama, salam dan instruksi sederhana saat orang berbicara pelan dan jelas.

objectives.letters-numbers-names: Mengenali huruf, angka dan nama yang diucapkan pelan

nodes.title: First Reading
nodes.summary: Read simple words and phrases, common signs, business cards and simple forms.
nodes.canDo: Can understand familiar words, common signs and the details on a business card or simple form.

objectives.text: Read simple words and short phrases
Understand common signs (Open, Closed, Exit, Toilet)
Read business cards and simple forms

id.title: Membaca Pertama
id.summary: Membaca kata dan frasa sederhana, papan tanda umum, kartu nama dan formulir sederhana.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami kata yang sudah dikenal, papan tanda umum, serta data di kartu nama atau formulir sederhana.

objectives.words-phrases: Membaca kata dan frasa pendek yang sederhana
objectives.signs: Memahami papan tanda umum (Open, Closed, Exit, Toilet)
objectives.cards-forms: Membaca kartu nama dan formulir sederhana

nodes.title: A0 Checkpoint
nodes.summary: A mixed test of every A0 strand: listening, reading, grammar and vocabulary questions plus greeting, spelling and a form.
nodes.canDo: Can show all A0 skills together: greet someone, spell their name and fill in a simple form.

objectives.text: Answer listening, reading, grammar and vocabulary questions from all A0 nodes
Greet someone and spell your name aloud
Fill in a simple form with your personal details

id.title: Checkpoint A0
id.summary: Tes campuran semua strand A0: soal menyimak, membaca, grammar dan kosakata, plus menyapa, mengeja nama dan mengisi formulir.
id.canDo: Bisa menunjukkan semua kemampuan A0 sekaligus: menyapa, mengeja nama dan mengisi formulir sederhana.

objectives.receptive: Menjawab soal menyimak, membaca, grammar dan kosakata dari semua node A0
objectives.greet-and-spell: Menyapa seseorang dan mengeja namamu dengan lantang
objectives.fill-form: Mengisi formulir sederhana dengan data pribadimu
